## Association with vegitational density

```{r association_temperature, warning=FALSE, comments="", message=FALSE, fig.dim=c(8, 10), cache=TRUE}
post_table$temperature %>% table()
  
temp_phylum_perc <- post_table %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "genome") %>%
  left_join(genome_metadata, by = "genome") %>%
  group_by(phylum) %>%
  summarise(positive = sum(density == "Positive"),
            percent_positive = mean(density == "Positive") * 100,
            negative = sum(density == "Negative"),
            percent_negative = mean(density == "Negative") * 100)

temp_phylum_perc %>% 
  arrange(-percent_positive)

temp_phylum_perc %>% 
  arrange(-percent_negative)

# Sub-phylum level

post_table %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "genome") %>%
  left_join(genome_metadata, by = "genome") %>%
  filter(phylum=="p__Bacillota_A") %>% 
  group_by(order) %>%
  summarise(positive = sum(density == "Positive"),
            percent_positive = mean(density == "Positive") * 100,
            negative = sum(density == "Negative"),
            percent_negative = mean(density == "Negative") * 100) %>% 
  arrange(-percent_positive)

post_table %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "genome") %>%
  left_join(genome_metadata, by = "genome") %>%
  filter(order=="o__TANB77") %>% 
  group_by(family) %>%
  summarise(positive = sum(density == "Positive"),
            percent_positive = mean(density == "Positive") * 100,
            negative = sum(density == "Negative"),
            percent_negative = mean(density == "Negative") * 100) %>% 
  arrange(-percent_positive)

post_table %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "genome") %>%
  left_join(genome_metadata, by = "genome") %>%
  filter(family=="f__CAG-508") %>% 
  group_by(genus) %>%
  summarise(positive = sum(density == "Positive"),
            percent_positive = mean(density == "Positive") * 100,
            negative = sum(density == "Negative"),
            percent_negative = mean(density == "Negative") * 100) %>% 
  arrange(-percent_positive)
```

```{r density_functions, warning=FALSE, comments="", message=FALSE}
functional_differences_density <- elements_response %>% 
  filter(density !="Neutral") %>% 
  mutate(density = droplevels(density)) %>%
  group_by(GIFT) %>%
  summarise(
    n_pos   = sum(density == "Positive"),
    n_neg   = sum(density == "Negative"),
    mean_pos = mean(value[density == "Positive"], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_neg = mean(value[density == "Negative"], na.rm = TRUE),
    diff     = mean_pos - mean_neg,
    p        = if (n_pos > 1 && n_neg > 1 &&
                   stats::sd(value[density == "Positive"], na.rm = TRUE) > 0 &&
                   stats::sd(value[density == "Negative"], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
                stats::t.test(value ~ density, var.equal = FALSE)$p.value
              } else NA_real_
  , .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")) %>%
  arrange(p_adj)
```


```{r density_functions_plot, warning=FALSE, comments="", message=FALSE}
fc_threshold <- 0.2      # minimum absolute mean difference to call interesting
fdr_threshold <- 0.05    # BH-adjusted p-value cutoff

functional_differences_density_logfold <- functional_differences_density %>%
  mutate(func = substr(GIFT, 1, 3)) %>% 
  mutate(
    # guard against p_adj = 0 or NA
    p_adj_plot = ifelse(is.na(p_adj) | p_adj == 0, .Machine$double.xmin, p_adj),
    neglog10_fdr = -log10(p_adj_plot),
    hit = !is.na(p_adj) & p_adj < fdr_threshold & abs(diff) >= fc_threshold
  ) %>% 
  mutate(func = ifelse(hit, func, "NS")) %>% 
  filter(neglog10_fdr<20)

palette_df <- functional_differences_density_logfold %>%
  dplyr::distinct(func) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    gift_colors %>% dplyr::select(func = Code_function, Color),
    by = "func"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Color = dplyr::case_when(
      func == "NS" & is.na(Color) ~ "grey70",
      is.na(Color)                ~ "#999999",
      TRUE                        ~ Color
    )
  )

color_values <- setNames(palette_df$Color, palette_df$func)

functional_differences_density_logfold %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = diff, y = neglog10_fdr, color=func)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = func), alpha = 0.8, size = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-fc_threshold, fc_threshold), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(fdr_threshold), linetype = "dashed") +
  ylim(0,15)+
  xlim(-0.6,0.6)+
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = subset(functional_differences_density_logfold, hit),
    aes(label = GIFT),
    size = 3, max.overlaps = 20, box.padding = 0.3, min.segment.length = 0
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_values, breaks = names(color_values)) +
  labs(
    x = "Mean difference (Positive − Negative)",
    y = expression(-log[10]("FDR (BH)")),
    color = "Group",
    subtitle = paste0("Thresholds: |diff| ≥ ", fc_threshold, ", FDR < ", fdr_threshold)
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```
